LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Relationship
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you help your b) Identify ways through which obligations towards their neighbour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Appreciate the love and care for  Learners act short skits neighbours as an act of ibadah. demonstrating good relations with neighbours.  Learners guided to role play on how to love and care for their neighbours
2. Demonstrate love and care for crutches people with special needs.  Learners dramatise how to take care of people with special needs

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
